entities.label: kpi
entities.description: Key performance indicator expressible in numerical and monetary value, such as revenue or net sales. Every word of the KPI name.

entities.label: cy
entities.description: The current year value of a KPI. Only the number, without a currency sign or a scale word such as million. Not a forecast or a limit that the company sets.

entities.label: py
entities.description: The prior year value of a KPI (current year minus 1). Only the number, without a currency sign or a scale word such as million. Not a forecast or a limit that the company sets.

entities.label: py1
entities.description: The value of a KPI two years before the current year. Only the number, without a currency sign or a scale word such as million. Not a forecast or a limit that the company sets.

entities.label: increase
entities.description: The number that gives an increase of a KPI from the previous year to the current year. Only the number, without a currency sign or a scale word.

entities.label: increase_py
entities.description: The number that gives an increase of a KPI from two years back to the prior year. Only the number, without a currency sign or a scale word.

entities.label: decrease
entities.description: The number that gives a decrease of a KPI from the previous year to the current year. Only the number, without a currency sign or a scale word.

entities.label: decrease_py
entities.description: The number that gives a decrease of a KPI from two years back to the prior year. Only the number, without a currency sign or a scale word.

entities.label: thereof
entities.description: A subordinate KPI: a KPI that is part of another, broader KPI. Every word of its name.

entities.label: attr
entities.description: Words that further describe a KPI and define its exact name.

entities.label: kpi_coref
entities.description: A co-reference to a KPI mentioned in a previous sentence.

relations.label: RELATED_VALUE
relations.description: Links a KPI to a value or change that belongs to it. The link has no direction.
